1.text:
NEVER WALK IN WHITE.
IF YOUR SHADOW'S SHORTER THAN YOU ARE, YOU'RE ALREADY LATE.
1.teach: A night runs until Shutter. Get under a roof before the white. Out in daylight your water burns, then your health. Shade only slows it. What the sun does to you stays until you sleep.

2.text:
Put white on before you leave, not when you feel it. When you feel it, it's done.
Lips first. They burn first and they don't heal right.
2.teach: White is money. Tins of zinc paste. You'll see your count by the drop meter.

3.text: Wet you didn't see come out of the ground is wet somebody wants you to drink.
3.teach: Water is life and medicine. Drink in battle to heal. Refill at home and at wells.

5.text:
HIT WHAT'S SOFT.
ON PEOPLE, KNEES. ON MACHINES, EYES.
THEN RUN. WINNING IS GETTING HOME.
5.teach: In battle, choose which part to hit. Break a machine's eye to stun it. Tap when the ring closes to parry.

last.text: Juno. If you're reading this by yourself, then

jflour_a.text:
Chayo sends flour up the hill every week and makes them swear not to say.
I said it anyway. She didn't stop. I think she wanted somebody to.

jflour_b.text:
I kept Chayo's secret.
Up the hill they thank God for her instead. She can't make Him stop.

jbell.text:
Two tins of white for a bell.
Benny held it the way you hold a baby. He says he'll ring it every Lamp. It was worth two tins.

jneto_a.text:
I told Rubén where his brother sleeps.
Now there's water by the doors every week, and Neto pretends he doesn't know who.

jneto_b.text:
Neto cut white with chalk so kids could have some.
I didn't say where he sleeps. Rubén only asked if he's alive. He is.

jcloud_a.text:
A machine in the dark gave me a cloud made of cloth. It said welcome the whole time.
I'll give it to Kit. He'll ask what rain feels like, and I still won't know.

jcloud_b.text:
I put the cloud back.
The machine straightened the row so nobody could tell. Somebody's coming back for it. That's what it thinks.

j4.text: Toña has his shoes. He walks easy.

j5.text: Lights at the lake. Kit says he'd clap back.

j6.text: NIM. She asked what day it was.
